effect_description_eng:
[On Play] If it's your turn, you may digivolve 1 of your Digimon into a Digimon card with the [Royal Knight] trait in your hand for its digivolution cost.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon digivolves into a Digimon with [Huckmon] in its name or [Royal Knight] trait , gain 1 memory.
